title: Pagination advances the page and announces the current position through an aria-live region
asA: operator paging through a long result set
iWant: the pagination control to advance the page, refetch the correct page from the query adapter, and announce the new position to assistive tech
soThat: screen-reader users know which page they are on without having to scan the whole surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable with server-side pagination, when the operator activates the next-page control, the client issues a request carrying `page` and `pageSize` and rerenders the returned rows. Probed indirectly through AC-17103-2 which asserts the announced position; direct request assertions carry via the `application-api-rest` contract.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with a next-page control
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates the next-page control
acceptanceCriteria.then: the query adapter receives `page` and `pageSize` and the rendered rows equal the returned rows

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable, an `aria-live="polite"` region renders the current position as `Page N of M`; when the operator advances the pagination, the region text updates to the new N. The check reads the region before and after clicking the next-page control, asserts the initial text matches `Page N of M`, and asserts the next click updates N. Probed by pack check AC-17103-2.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with a pagination control and an aria-live status region
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates the pagination control
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aria-live region text updates from `Page N of M` to `Page N+1 of M`

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable, the pagination controls (previous, next, page number links where present) are reachable in tab order and activate on `Enter` or `Space` without pointer input.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with a pagination control
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator tabs into the pagination region
acceptanceCriteria.then: each pagination control receives focus and activates on `Enter` or `Space`

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the query adapter rejects the pagination request (an HTTP 4xx/5xx, a network error, or a client-cancelled fetch), when the response settles, then the loading indicator clears and the announced error region replaces the pending state naming the failed operation; the rendered rows retain the last successful state until the operator retries.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a pending pagination request whose fetch rejects
acceptanceCriteria.when: the query adapter's response settles as a failure
acceptanceCriteria.then: the loading indicator clears, an announced error region reports the failed operation, and the last successful rows remain
